hasMenuItem.name: Celebration Box
hasMenuItem.description: The box includes all our special products, such as one portion of mini pancakes, one portion mini French crepes, four pieces puffy donuts, around twenty pieces mini churros, six pieces mini loops churros coated in cinnamon sugar with three sauces.

hasMenuItem.name: Classic Churros
hasMenuItem.description: Five pieces of Spanish churros sticks with any free two sauces — Nutella, Kinder, Pistachio, Lotus or Caramel — and choice of sugar or cinnamon.

hasMenuItem.name: Mini Churros
hasMenuItem.description: 15 pieces of Spanish mini churros with choice of two sauces — Nutella, Kinder, Pistachio, Lotus or Caramel — and choice of sugar or cinnamon.

hasMenuItem.name: Mini Loops
hasMenuItem.description: 5 pieces of mini loop with your choice of 2 sauces.

hasMenuItem.name: Mixed Churros
hasMenuItem.description: 16 pieces of mixed churros, 4 each of Classic, Wonder, Loops and Mini Churros coated in cinnamon sugar with choice of 4 sauces.

hasMenuItem.name: Wonder Churros
hasMenuItem.description: 5 pieces of Spanish filled churros with available sauces: Nutella, Kinder, Pistachio, Lotus or Caramel, and choice of sugar or cinnamon.

hasMenuItem.name: Mega Loop
hasMenuItem.description: Mega loop Spanish churros with any 2 sauces of your choice on top.

hasMenuItem.name: Mini Waffle
hasMenuItem.description: 10 pieces of mini Belgian square-shaped waffle served with choice of 3 free sauces: Nutella, Kinder, Pistachio, Lotus, Caramel or White Chocolate, and additional choice of fruits.

hasMenuItem.name: Waffle Triple
hasMenuItem.description: Belgian square-shaped waffle served with choice of 3 free sauces: Nutella, Kinder, Pistachio, Lotus, Caramel or White Chocolate, and additional choice of fruits.

hasMenuItem.name: Dubai Chocolate Crepe
hasMenuItem.description: Dubai chocolate crepe, a delicate French crepe filled with pistachio kunafa chocolate sauce, covered in rich Belgian milk chocolate and drizzled with smooth white chocolate for the perfect indulgence.

hasMenuItem.name: Signature Ice Cream Crepe
hasMenuItem.description: Rich milk chocolate and a drizzle of hazelnut spread.

hasMenuItem.name: Mini Pancake
hasMenuItem.description: 10 pieces of mini pancake served with choice of any 3 free sauces: Nutella, Kinder, Pistachio, Lotus, Caramel or White Chocolate, and additional choice of fruits.

hasMenuItem.name: Hola Box
hasMenuItem.description: Our signature desserts box: 8 classic churros, 3 Wonder Churros, fresh strawberries and mini pancakes served with choice of 4 sauces and cinnamon sugar.

hasMenuItem.name: Puffy Donut
hasMenuItem.description: 6 pieces of puffy donuts filled with choices of Pistachio, Kinder, Nutella, Caramel or Lotus sauce.

hasMenuItem.name: Matcha Frappe
hasMenuItem.description: Cool and creamy blend of fine matcha, lightly sweetened and blended to smooth perfection. It is earthy, energizing and your new green obsession.

hasMenuItem.name: Matcha Latte
hasMenuItem.description: Finest quality matcha, brewed to perfection and topped with milk foam.

hasMenuItem.name: Salted Caramel Matcha
hasMenuItem.description: Finest quality matcha brewed to perfection with salted caramel milk foam.

hasMenuItem.name: Dark Mocha Shaken Espresso
hasMenuItem.description: Espresso shaken with dark chocolate and milk — cold, frothy, and bold.

hasMenuItem.name: Iced Americano
hasMenuItem.description: Made with dark espresso and ice, it's the perfect way to relax and cool off during those hot summer days or anytime you're craving a refreshing coffee.

hasMenuItem.name: Iced Caramel Macchiato
hasMenuItem.description: Indulge in the rich and creamy flavor of Iced Caramel Macchiato, a luxurious blend of freshly brewed espresso, creamy milk and sweet caramel syrup, served over ice.

hasMenuItem.name: Iced Latte
hasMenuItem.description: Made with rich espresso, milk and ice, it's the perfect way to refresh and revitalize yourself during hot summer days, or anytime you crave a refreshing coffee.

hasMenuItem.name: Iced Spanish Latte
hasMenuItem.description: Made with rich espresso, milk and ice, the perfect drink for those hot summer days.

hasMenuItem.name: Iced V60
hasMenuItem.description: A chilled slow brew for those who appreciate clean aromatic coffee notes. Perfect for hot days when you need a refreshing caffeine boost.

hasMenuItem.name: White Mocha Shaken Espresso
hasMenuItem.description: Espresso shaken with white chocolate and milk — cold, frothy, and bold.

hasMenuItem.name: New York Cheesecake
hasMenuItem.description: Classic cheesecake-flavoured milkshake.

hasMenuItem.name: Oreo Cream
hasMenuItem.description: Oreo-flavoured milkshake.

hasMenuItem.name: Blue Lagoon Mojito
hasMenuItem.description: Blue curacao flavor, lime and mint muddled in choice of 7 Up or Redbull.

hasMenuItem.name: Passion Fruit Mojito
hasMenuItem.description: Fresh passion fruit, lime and mint muddled with choice of 7 Up or Redbull.

hasMenuItem.name: Passion Ice Tea
hasMenuItem.description: Passion fruit signature iced tea.

hasMenuItem.name: Peach Iced Tea
hasMenuItem.description: Quench your thirst with our Peach Iced Tea, a refreshing and fruity blend of premium tea leaves and juicy peaches, perfect for sipping any time of the day.

hasMenuItem.name: Peach Mojito
hasMenuItem.description: Fresh peach, lime and mint muddled with choice of 7 Up or Redbull.

hasMenuItem.name: Tropical Dragon Lemonade
hasMenuItem.description: Refreshing lemonade with mango, lemon and mint flavours alongside dragon fruit cubes. Tart, sweet and pink.
